sloka: ऋषयः पितरो देवा गन्धर्वा गरुडोरगाः।शतक्रतुं पुरस्कृत्य ररक्षुर्लक्ष्मणं रणे ।। ६.९१.६४ ।।
transliteration: ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā gandharvā garuḍoragāḥ।śatakratuṁ puraskṛtya rarakṣurlakṣmaṇaṁ raṇe ।। 6.91.64 ।।

translations.english: As the frightful war between Vanaras and Rakshasas went on, many beings surrounded in the sky were astonished and looked charming.
